title: HTML to Markdown Converter
description: Convert HTML to clean Markdown or render Markdown to HTML with GFM support

instructions.title: How to use HTML to Markdown Converter

steps.title: Select conversion mode
steps.description: Choose 'HTML → Markdown' to convert HTML code into clean Markdown syntax, or 'Markdown → HTML' to render Markdown as formatted HTML output.

steps.title: Paste your input
steps.description: Paste HTML markup or Markdown text into the input area. Conversion happens automatically as you type, with no button needed.

steps.title: Configure options (HTML → MD mode)
steps.description: Click 'Options' to customize heading style (ATX # or Setext underline), bullet marker (-, *, +), code block style (fenced ``` or indented), and horizontal rule character.

steps.title: Copy or swap the result
steps.description: Click 'Copy Output' to copy the converted text to clipboard. Use 'Swap' to flip input and output and reverse the conversion direction automatically.

features: Table conversion with full GFM syntax
Code block and inline code support
Fenced or indented code block style
Swap button to reverse conversion direction
useCases: Convert blog posts from HTML CMS to Markdown for static sites
Turn GitHub README HTML previews back into editable Markdown
Migrate content from WordPress or Drupal to Markdown-based platforms
Convert documentation from HTML to Markdown for version control
Render Markdown previews for documentation tools
Prepare HTML email templates as Markdown drafts
Convert HTML tables to GFM Markdown table syntax
Clean up copy-pasted HTML from WYSIWYG editors
proTips: Use ATX heading style (# H1) for better compatibility with GitHub and most Markdown parsers
Enable 'Preview' in Markdown → HTML mode to see the rendered output before copying
The 'Swap' button automatically switches the conversion direction — paste HTML, convert, then swap to edit Markdown
Fenced code blocks (```) are more portable than indented code blocks across platforms
GFM tables require proper | column | alignment — if your HTML table has colspan, it will be simplified
troubleshooting: If HTML with inline styles converts poorly, strip styles first — Turndown ignores most CSS
Deeply nested HTML lists may not convert perfectly — simplify the structure if needed
HTML with JavaScript or complex attributes will be stripped — only semantic tags are converted
If Markdown tables appear misaligned, ensure your HTML table has proper thead/tbody structure
Very large inputs may take a moment — process in chunks if performance is a concern

pageDescription: Convert any HTML to clean, readable Markdown in seconds — or render Markdown back to HTML. Paste raw markup, upload an .html file, or enter a page URL to fetch and convert in one click. Supports GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM): tables, fenced code blocks, strikethrough, task lists, links, and images. Perfect for migrating WordPress or Drupal content to static sites, editing GitHub READMEs, writing for Notion or Obsidian, and cleaning up WYSIWYG editor output. Fully configurable output (ATX/Setext headings, bullet markers, code style) — free, browser-based, no account required.
